title: chained-logical-or-assignment-subsequent-operand (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: Short-circuit OR tests the reassigned value for null before accessing its method. The final operand sees Service, not the previous string.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago false_positive: unexpected diagnostic(s): invalid-method-access@11.
